_about: Garment style catalogue for auto-onboarding (M-14), keyed by the manufacturer style = Books SKU. Built by tools/online-order/build-styles.py from the InkSoft thread's M-15 style proposal (style-catalogue-proposal-2026-10-19.csv); do not hand-edit -- change the overrides in that script. name = what the note writes (staff wording kept where staff already wrote it, INK-24); vendor = 'Vendors Used', always the supplier (D-41); kind = the form's Garment Kind (src/placements.js); age = Adult / Youth / Infant-Toddler; kind + age give the Books report category (src/garmentCategories.js, D-43); successor = the style a sunset one is replaced by (D-42).
